plan.driftNoOverwrite: This agent's setup was changed by hand. To avoid overwriting your changes, restore first.
plan.friendlyReplace: This replaces the prompt {{tool}} uses now.
plan.friendlyFresh: After this, {{tool}} starts using this prompt.
plan.friendlyOff: After this, {{tool}} stops using this prompt.
plan.friendlySafe: What is there now is backed up first. You can turn it off or restore it any time.
plan.friendlyReload: Restart {{tool}} after deploying for it to take effect.
plan.friendlyReconcile: Keysmith's managed lines in {{tool}}'s config were moved or rewritten. Tidying backs the file up first, puts those lines back, and leaves your own settings as they are.
plan.blockerConfigDrift: {{tool}}'s config was changed after the last deploy.
plan.blockerInstructionsMissing: The model_instructions_file line Keysmith wrote (pointing to {{ref}}) is no longer in this agent's config. It may have been edited by hand or by another tool, so Keysmith cannot tell whether it is safe to overwrite. Your config.toml was not changed.
plan.blockerDryRun: The pre-check found {{count}} problem(s) that block this. No files were changed.
plan.blockerInstructionsRepointed: model_instructions_file in the config now points to a different file; Keysmith expected {{ref}}. It will not overwrite it.
plan.blockerOwnership: The deployment record does not match the current config: {{detail}}
plan.blockerPermissionDenied: Permission denied: the current user does not have Full Control over the agent's home directory. Grant Full Control (Windows ACL) and try again.
plan.hintCleanup: "Clean up" at the bottom left clears this stale deployment record and keeps your config.toml. It also permanently deletes this agent's session history and login, and that cannot be undone. To keep your chats, back up the whole .codex folder first, then decide whether to clean up.
plan.hintReconcile: Use "Tidy config" at the bottom left first, then deploy.
plan.reconciled: Config tidied. You can deploy now.
plan.confirmSalvage: Keep current config and turn off
plan.salvageButton: Keep current config and turn off…
plan.friendlySalvage: The config backup {{tool}} saved before deploying is gone, so it can't be put back exactly. Turning off keeps config.toml as it is now and removes only the part Keysmith wrote; the prompt file and hooks are restored as usual.
plan.salvageNotice: The config backup from before deploying can't be found (cleanup may have removed it), so restoring from backup has nothing to restore. You can keep your current config and turn off instead.

data.clearAllHint: Deletes the prompt library, history, backups, and logs. Irreversible. A normal uninstall keeps these files. Versions saved before a cleanup are not included; delete those under Versions.
data.clearSecond: I have read the scope and confirm this cannot be undone

extensions.title: Extension packs
extensions.lead: Prompt packs published by the official source. They update on their own, apart from the app.
extensions.offBody: Keysmith Switch reads the official source only once this is on. It fetches the list and the packs you choose, and uploads nothing of yours.
extensions.notDeployed: Installed prompts go into your library only. Nothing is deployed automatically.
extensions.uninstallBody: This removes the prompts from this pack that you have not edited and that no agent is using. Edited or running ones stay.
extensions.emptyHint: When something new is published, the Extensions button shows a count.
extensions.installedToast: Added to your library: {{added}} new, not deployed
extensions.updatedToast: Updated: {{updated}} changed, {{added}} new, {{copied}} saved beside your edits

err.offline: Could not reach the source. Showing the last list.
err.too-new: This source needs a newer version of the app.
err.invalid: This pack broke the rules and was not installed.
err.incompatible: This pack needs a newer app.
err.unknown-pack: That pack is no longer in the source.
err.store: That failed and nothing was changed.
err.default: That failed and nothing was changed.

extensions.disableBody: The app stops checking the source and hides this list. Prompts already in your library stay, and you can turn this back on any time.
extensions.upToDate: All extension packs are up to date
extensions.updatedAllToast: Updated {{count}} packs: {{updated}} changed, {{added}} new, {{copied}} saved beside your edits
extensions.updatedSomeToast: Updated {{done}} of {{total}} packs; the rest were left as they were

rules.previewBody: This pack adds a read-only table to Input rewrite. It replaces text you send to Codex using the rules below. Your prompt library is not touched.
rules.updatedToast: Rule pack updated. A table that is on switches only after you accept it on the Rewrite page
rules.uninstallBody: Removes this table from Input rewrite. Anything you copied to My rules stays.

cleanup.buttonHint: Return this agent to a fresh install: setup, logins and history removed, a version saved first (without logins)
cleanup.title: Clean up {{tool}}
cleanup.nothing: Nothing to clean: this agent looks like a fresh install already.
cleanup.willRemoveDeployment: Turn off and remove the deployed prompt{{title}}
cleanup.unsaved: The prompt text could not be read back, so it cannot be restored after cleaning.
cleanup.willEmptyMemory: Empty {{file}} ({{lines}} lines, {{size}}), including what you wrote in it
cleanup.extraSavedWithoutLogin: Save and remove {{name}} ({{files}} files, {{size}}), without its login
cleanup.extraErased: Delete {{name}} ({{files}} files, {{size}}); not saved — it holds history or a login
cleanup.loginInKeychain: Remove this agent's login from the system keychain; not saved
cleanup.untouched: Not touched: files in your projects (including git projects), your prompt library, the agent app itself.
cleanup.saves: A version is saved first, so you can roll back in Settings → Versions. Logins, session history and caches are deleted and are not in it: you will have to sign in again.
cleanup.ack: I understand this empties what I wrote in {{file}}
cleanup.rewriteDisconnected: Input rewrite was disconnected for this agent, so it connects directly again. Your rules are kept; reconnect it on the Input rewrite page.
cleanup.repair: This agent's setup changed after the last deploy; repair it before cleaning.
cleanup.drifted: This agent's config was changed by hand after the last deploy. The deployed prompt is left for a repair; everything listed here is still cleaned.
cleanup.memoriesOption: Save and move out the memories folder ({{files}} files, {{size}})
cleanup.agentRunning: {{tool}} is running. Quit it first: its sessions, memories and login are in use.

versions.title: Versions
versions.lead: A version is saved before every cleanup. Pick one to put that prompt and memory file back.
versions.emptyHint: After you clean an agent, a version shows up here.
versions.deleteBody: You will not be able to roll back to it.
versions.willReplace: It replaces what is in use now{{title}}
versions.currentMemory: {{file}} has {{size}} now; it is saved as a version first.
versions.savesCurrent: The current state is saved as a version first, so this rollback can be undone too.
versions.cannotRedeploy: This version has no saved prompt text; only the memory file can be restored.
versions.nothingToRestore: Nothing in this version can be restored.
versions.rolledBackSaved: Rolled back. The state before it was saved as a version.
versions.willRestoreMemories: Put the memories folder back as it was ({{files}} files, {{size}})
versions.willRestoreExtraWithoutLogin: Put {{name}} back, without its login (only if there is none now)
versions.noLoginBack: Logins and session history were deleted by the cleanup and do not come back: sign in again after rolling back.
versions.currentMemories: The memories folder has {{files}} files now; it is saved as a version first.
versions.memoriesRunning: Codex is running. Quit it to restore its memories folder.

announcements.lead: News from Keysmith: what this version brings, what comes next, and how each agent signs in.
announcements.emptyHint: New announcements show up here, and a dot appears on the bell.

rewrite.title: Input rewrite
rewrite.lead: Type as usual. Your rules are applied before the model sees your words; the input box and history keep what you typed.

master.label: Input rewrite master switch
master.pausedBanner: Paused: nothing is replaced. Your rules are kept.

agents.heading: Agents
agents.hint: Applies only to connected agents. Connecting changes one setting of that agent; disconnecting restores only that setting.

status.notRunning: The relay isn't running; {{agent}} can't reach the model
status.unrouted: {{count}} new {{what}} don't go through the relay yet; reconnect

details.oauth: Your sign-in token passes through the local relay and is never stored or logged.

connect.title: Connect {{agent}}
connect.body: This changes {{field}} in {{file}} so {{agent}} sends requests through a relay that only listens on this computer. Disconnecting restores only that value.
connect.disconnectBody: {{agent}} goes back to connecting directly. Only the value Keysmith wrote in {{file}} is restored; if another tool changed it, it's left alone. Your rules are kept.

bypassed.claude: The address in settings.json changed, or a project setting overrides it
bypassed.zcode: A provider's address was changed in ZCode
bypassed.grok: The Keysmith region in config.toml was edited or removed

codex.no-config: Codex's config.toml was not found. Run Codex once, then connect.
codex.built-in-provider: Codex is signed in with its built-in OpenAI provider, which isn't supported yet. Use a custom provider.
codex.missing-provider: The model_provider in config.toml has no matching provider entry.
codex.no-base-url: The current provider has no base_url.
codex.not-http: The current provider's base_url is not an http(s) address.
codex.wire-api: The current provider doesn't use the Responses API.

claude.no-config: Claude Code's settings folder was not found.
claude.bad-settings: settings.json isn't valid JSON. Fix it first.
claude.bedrock: Bedrock signs each request, so a rewritten request would fail. Not supported.
claude.not-http: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is not an http(s) address.

zcode.no-config: ZCode's provider settings were not found. Add a provider in ZCode first.
zcode.no-provider: Only Coding Plan sign-in is set up, which isn't supported yet. Add a provider that uses an API key.

grok.no-config: Grok's folder was not found. Run Grok once first.
grok.no-catalog: Grok hasn't fetched its model list yet. Run Grok once first.
grok.bad-region: The Keysmith region in config.toml is incomplete. Fix it first.

rules.heading: Rules
rules.hint: When tables match at the same spot, the one higher up wins. My rules always come first.
rules.howBody: Exact, case-sensitive matches. At any spot the longest rule wins; replaced text isn't replaced again; messages starting with / are skipped. Only what you type changes; assistant replies, tool output and the agent's own context are left alone.
rules.scopeEmpty: Pick at least one agent; to stop a table, turn it off.

rewrite.copyHint: Merged into My rules; text already there is skipped
rewrite.readOnly: Rule packs are read-only. Copy one to My rules to change it.
rewrite.pending: v{{version}} is waiting for your OK
rewrite.reviewBodyOn: This table is on. Once you accept, the new rules apply from the next message.
rewrite.reviewBodyOff: This table is off. Accepting switches it to the new version; it applies once you turn it on.

editor.emptyFrom: Text to match cannot be empty
